memory.scope: Published architectural cache-memory result; not a measured decode-speed benchmark.

timing.metric: Published end-to-end wall-clock time, compared to simulated prefill + decode time.
timing.precision_note: BF16 assumed in simulator. Exact serving dtype, kernel version, clocks, and network overhead are not fully specified by this table.

hardware_model_note: Capacity and HBM bandwidth use numeric SI bytes. H100/H200 use Hopper compute/cache parameters from the repository, with H200 sharing the H100 compute model. These are GPU-like estimates, not full device calibrations.
